transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I… I came because there’s been stuff going on at my apartment. People there are watching when I come and go, and I’m pretty sure they’ve been leaving notes about me with the office. Everyone keeps saying they’re just regular notices on the doors, but… that’s not what it feels like.
Do you feel like you are being watched or followed even when you’re not at your apartment?

Mostly at my apartment. That’s where I notice it… people watching when I leave or come back, and those notes getting slipped to the office. Folks keep saying they’re just door notices, but I don’t think that’s all it is.
Have you ever felt like people were watching or talking about you even when you weren’t at your apartment?

Not really… it’s mostly at my apartment. That’s where I notice them watching when I come and go, and those notes about me getting slipped to the office. People say they’re just notices, but… I don’t buy that.
Have you ever had experiences outside of your apartment where you felt people were plotting against you or talking about you in a harmful way?

No… not really outside. It’s mostly where I live. People there watch when I come and go, and those notes… they keep saying they’re just door notices, but I know some of it is about me going to the office.
Have you ever had any thoughts that people were against you or talking about you in a harmful way when you were somewhere other than your apartment, like at work or in public places?

No… not at work or places like that. It’s really at my apartment. I know the people there watch when I come and go, and those notes about me get slipped to the office… even if everybody keeps saying they’re just door notices.
Have you ever had any thoughts or feelings that people were trying to harm you or talk about you in a harmful way in places other than your apartment, even if just for a short time?

No… I mean, not really other places. It’s at my apartment. That’s where I know they’re watching when I come and go, and those notes about me getting sent to the office… people keep saying they’re just notices, but I don’t think so.
Have you ever felt that people were trying to harm you or talk about you in a harmful way, even when you weren’t thinking about your apartment or the notes?

No… not really. It comes back to the apartment. That’s why I came in. The people there watching me come and go, and those notes getting to the office… people say they’re just door notices, but I don’t buy that.
Do you believe the notes being left are evidence that people are plotting against you or trying to do you harm?

Yeah… I mean, that’s what it looks like to me. They keep saying they’re just door notices, but I don’t believe that. I think people at the apartment are watching when I come and go and sending notes about me to the office.
Even though others have told you that the notes are just regular notices, do you still believe they are about you and meant to harm or monitor you?

Yeah… I still think they’re about me. People keep saying they’re just regular notices, but that’s not what it feels like. I think they’re watching when I come and go and sending stuff about me to the office.

Even though others have told you that the people in your apartment are not watching you and the notes are just regular notices, do you still believe they are specifically about you and meant to monitor or harm you?

Yeah… I do. I know what people keep telling me, but I don’t believe it’s just regular notices. They’re watching when I come and go, and those notes are about me… going to the office. That’s why I came in.

Even though others have told you that the people in your apartment are not watching you and the notes are just regular notices, do you believe that no one can convince you otherwise because you just know it’s true?

Yeah… I mean, I know what I know. People can say it’s just door notices, but that’s not how it is. They’re watching when I come and go, and those notes are about me going to the office. That’s why I came in.
Can you think of any explanation or proof that would make you believe that the people in your apartment are not watching you and that the notes are not about you?
I don’t know what would prove it. Everybody keeps saying they’re just notices on the doors, but… I came in because I know they’re watching when I come and go and sending notes about me to the office.
Can you think of any explanation or proof that would make you believe that the people in your apartment are not watching you and that the notes are not about you?
I don’t really know. I mean… people keep saying they’re just notices on the doors, but I still know they’re watching when I come and go, and those notes are about me going to the office.
Even if someone were to show you that the notices on the doors are the same for everyone and there’s no specific mention of you, would you still believe they are meant for you or about you?

Yeah… I think I would. I know people say they’re just the same notices, but it still feels like it’s about me. They’re watching when I come and go, and those notes end up being about me going to the office.
